question: According to the Census - 2011, what is the average annual growth rate of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.64%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **2011 Census of India,** the average annual growth rate of India's population **between 2001 and 2011** was **1.64%.**
 
• This means that the **population grew by an average of 1.64% each year **during that period.
 
• 2011 census: 
 
 
• C M Chandramauli was the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India for the 2011 Indian Census.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state.
 
• Maharashtra is the second most populous state in India.
 
• The sex ratio in the country is 943 females per 1000 males.
 
 
• Haryana has the lowest sex ratio with just 879 women per 1000 males.
 
 
 
• **Bihar** has the highest population density.
 
• The overall literacy rate in India is 74% according to the 2011 census.
 
• Bihar is the least literate state in India, with a literacy of 61.8%.
 
• Goa was the most urbanized state with 62.17% of the population living in urban areas.
